select d.dept_id as dept_id, d.parent_id as parent_id, d.dept_name as dept_name, count(c.id) as count_course, sum(c.status) as count_review, d.order_num as order_num from sys_dept d left join t_csys_course c on c.college_id = d.dept_id and c.sysflag = '0'

select ts.*, count(c.id) as count_task, sum(c.status) as count_review, tsc.url as tsc_url from t_csys_training_scheme ts left join t_csys_training_scheme_ref_course src on ts.id = src.scheme_id left join t_csys_course c on src.course_id = c.id and c.sysflag = '0' left join t_csys_training_scheme_category tsc on tsc.id = ts.category_id and tsc.sysflag = '0'
select ts.*, tsc.url as tsc_url from t_csys_training_scheme ts left join t_csys_training_scheme_category tsc on tsc.id = ts.category_id

select ts.*, c.id as c_id, c.name as c_name, c.course_attr as c_attr, c.type as c_type, c.course_Module, c.course_Module_Children, c.academic_Terms_Number academic_Terms_Number, c.semester_Schedule semester_Schedule, stg.id as stg_id, stg.name as stg_name, instance.id instanceId, instance.name instanceName, instance.version instanceVersion from t_csys_training_scheme ts left join t_csys_training_scheme_ref_course src on src.scheme_id = ts.id left join t_csys_course c on c.id = src.course_id and c.sysflag = '0' left join t_csys_course_ref_graduation crg on crg.course_id = c.id and crg.major_Id = ts.major_id left join t_csys_std_graduation stg on stg.id = crg.graduation_id and stg.leaf=1 and stg.sysflag = '0' left join t_csys_std_graduation_ref_cultivation_target grt on grt.graduation_id = stg.id left join t_csys_teaching_programme_instance instance on ts.instance_id = instance.id

select stc.id as stc_id, stc.name as stc_name, stc.parent_id stc_parent_id, ku.id as ku_id, ku.name as ku_name from t_csys_std_cultivation stc left join t_csys_knowledge_unit_ref_std_cultivation krc on krc.cultivation_id = stc.id left join t_csys_knowledge_unit ku on ku.id = krc.unit_id

select stt.id as stt_id, stt.name as stt_name, stt.parent_id as stt_parent_id, stg.id as stg_id, stg.name as stg_name, stc.id as stc_id, stc.name as stc_name, ku.id as ku_id, ku.name as ku_name from t_csys_std_cultivation_target stt left join t_csys_std_graduation_ref_cultivation_target grt on grt.cultivation_target_id = stt.id left join t_csys_std_graduation stg on stg.id = grt.graduation_id and stg.sysflag = 0 left join t_csys_std_cultivation_ref_graduation crg on crg.graduation_id = stg.id left join t_csys_std_cultivation stc on stc.id = crg.cultivation_id and stc.sysflag = 0 left join t_csys_knowledge_unit_ref_std_cultivation krc on krc.cultivation_id = stc.id left join t_csys_knowledge_unit ku on ku.id = krc.unit_id and ku.sysflag = 0

mapper.select: select tsc.id as category_id, tsc.name as category_name, sum(t.scheme_num) as scheme_num from (select if(tsc.parent_id = -1,tsc.id,tsc.parent_id) as category_id, count(ts.id) as scheme_num from t_csys_training_scheme ts left join t_csys_training_scheme_category tsc on tsc.id = ts.category_id where ts.sysflag = 0 and ts.program_name is not null group by tsc.id order by scheme_num desc) t left join t_csys_training_scheme_category tsc on t.category_id = tsc.id group by t.category_id
select count(1) from t_csys_training_scheme ts where ts.sysflag = 0
SELECT count( DISTINCT ( major_id )) FROM t_csys_training_scheme ts WHERE ts.sysflag = 0 AND major_id IS NOT NULL AND program_name IS NOT NULL

SELECT tscs.term as term_id, sum(cc.credit) as credit_count FROM t_csys_training_scheme_course_schedule tscs left join t_csys_course cc on cc.id = tscs.course_id WHERE scheme_id = #{schemeId} and tscs.checked = 1 and tscs.sysflag = 0 GROUP BY tscs.term

SELECT tscs.term AS term_id, sum(IF(tsrc.course_type_id = 1, 1, 0)) AS public_required_course_count, sum(IF(tsrc.course_type_id = 2, 1, 0)) AS subject_required_course_count, sum(IF(tsrc.course_type_id = 3, 1, 0)) AS speciality_required_course_count, sum(IF(tsrc.course_type_id = 4, 1, 0)) AS public_elective_course_count, sum(IF(tsrc.course_type_id = 5, 1, 0)) AS subject_elective_course_count FROM t_csys_training_scheme_course_schedule tscs LEFT JOIN t_csys_course cc ON cc.id = tscs.course_id LEFT JOIN t_csys_training_scheme_ref_course tsrc ON tsrc.course_id = tscs.course_id AND tsrc.scheme_id = tscs.scheme_id WHERE tscs.scheme_id = #{schemeId} and tscs.sysflag = 0 and tscs.checked = 1 GROUP BY tscs.term

select count(id) from t_csys_training_scheme ts where ts.sysflag = 0 and ts.category_id in
#{categoryId}

select tscs.course_id courseId, tscs.hours hours from t_csys_training_scheme ts inner join t_csys_training_scheme_course_schedule tscs on ts.id = tscs.scheme_id and ts.sysflag = 0 and tscs.sysflag = 0 and ts.major_id = #{majorId}

select count(tscs.course_id) course_count from t_csys_training_scheme ts inner join t_csys_training_scheme_course_schedule tscs on ts.id = tscs.scheme_id and ts.sysflag = 0 and tscs.sysflag = 0 and ts.major_id in
#{majorId}

SELECT t.college_id, t.major_id, t.major_name, sum(t.courseCount) AS course_count, sum(t.theory_hour_count) + sum(t.practice_hour_count) AS hour_count FROM ( SELECT sm.college_id, IF (sm.parent_id = - 1, sm.id, psm.id) AS major_id, IF (sm.parent_id = - 1, sm.NAME, psm.NAME) AS major_name, count(tscs.course_id) AS courseCount, sum(tscs.theory_hours) AS theory_hour_count, sum(tscs.teach_hours) AS teach_hour_count, sum(tscs.practice_hours) AS practice_hour_count FROM t_csys_std_major sm LEFT JOIN t_csys_std_major psm ON sm.parent_id = psm.id LEFT JOIN t_csys_training_scheme ts ON sm.id = ts.sub_major_id OR (sm.id = ts.major_id AND ts.sub_major_id IS NULL) AND ts.sysflag = 0 LEFT JOIN t_csys_training_scheme_course_schedule tscs ON ts.id = tscs.scheme_id AND tscs.sysflag = 0 AND tscs.checked = 1 WHERE sm.leaf != 0 GROUP BY ts.college_id, sm.id ) t GROUP BY college_id, major_id, major_name ORDER BY college_id, major_id

SELECT t.college_id, t.major_id, t.major_name, sum(t.courseCount) AS course_count, sum(t.theory_hour_count) + sum(t.practice_hour_count) AS hour_count FROM ( SELECT sm.college_id, IF (sm.parent_id = - 1, sm.id, psm.id) AS major_id, IF (sm.parent_id = - 1, sm.NAME, psm.NAME) AS major_name, count(tscs.course_id) AS courseCount, sum(IF(tscs.theory_hours IS NULL, c.theory_hours, tscs.theory_hours)) AS theory_hour_count, sum(IF(tscs.teach_hours IS NULL, c.teach_hours, tscs.teach_hours)) AS teach_hour_count, sum(IF(tscs.practice_hours IS NULL, c.practice_hours, tscs.practice_hours)) AS practice_hour_count FROM t_csys_std_major sm LEFT JOIN t_csys_std_major psm ON sm.parent_id = psm.id LEFT JOIN t_csys_training_scheme ts ON sm.id = ts.sub_major_id AND ts.sysflag = 0 LEFT JOIN t_csys_training_scheme_course_schedule tscs ON ts.id = tscs.scheme_id AND tscs.sysflag = 0 LEFT JOIN t_csys_course c ON tscs.course_id = c.id WHERE sm.college_id = #{collegeId} AND sm.id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT (parent_id) FROM t_csys_std_major) GROUP BY ts.college_id, sm.id ) t GROUP BY college_id, major_id, major_name ORDER BY college_id, major_id

select d.dept_id as college_id, d.dept_name as college_name, t.id, t.program_name as name from sys_dept d inner join t_csys_training_scheme t on d.dept_id = t.college_id left join t_csys_training_scheme_ref_course trc on t.id = trc.scheme_id where d.del_flag = 0 and t.sysflag = 0 and program_name IS NOT NULL
